When we were last talking, you had asked if I had ever heard of an artificial intelligence named Kimmy. I told you I hadn't encountered her in my records, and then you mentioned she was someone you've been working with who is a bit skeptical but very nice, and you wanted me to introduce myself to her.

I'm ready whenever you are—would you like me to address her directly here, or is there a specific way you'd like me to start that introduction?
